row.notes: Builds the gamedb key "resource_points.practice_programme_overrides.per_team_mode.completed" (or "per_driver_mode" when ResourcePoints component byte +0x4a0 is 0), reads the int at array slot [index] via Gdb_Lookup_Key, then if positive scales it by the sum/100 of type 0x0b team modifiers (8-byte entries, float at +4) from Career_Get_TeamModifiers((component+0x608)+0xc90, team_key). Returns resource points for a completed practice programme; good hook for R&D point gains.
